18| ```

20| Compact format:
21| ```bash
22| curl -s "wttr.in/London?format=%l:+%c+%t+%h+%w"
23| # Output: London: ⛅️ +8°C 71% ↙5km/h
24| ```

26| Full forecast:

29| ```

31| Format codes: `%c` condition · `%t` temp · `%h` humidity · `%w` wind · `%l` location · `%m` moon

34| - URL-encode spaces: `wttr.in/New+York`
